summary: Ran independent backend/frontend regression after backend modular refactor. Core API routing, auth cookies, favorites, football, stories, and gamification flows are working; found two auth hardening regressions.

critical.issue: CORS preflight from public endpoint returns access-control-allow-origin='*' and no access-control-allow-credentials. Expected explicit origin with credentials for cookie auth.
No brute-force lockout after 5 failed login attempts; valid credentials still succeed immediately (200).

action_items: Implement and enforce login lockout/rate-limit policy after repeated failed auth attempts (>=5).
Fix deployed CORS policy for /api auth routes to return explicit allow-origin and allow-credentials=true for configured frontend origin.
critical_code_review_comments: Deployed CORS behavior does not match server.py expectation (explicit FRONTEND_URL + credentials). Likely ingress/edge override or env mismatch.
Auth router has no failed-attempt tracking/temporary lock mechanism, so brute-force lockout requirement is not implemented.
seed_admin password update path exists in code (auth_service.seed_admin) but was not mutation-tested in this run.
Admin password hash in Mongo verified as bcrypt $2b$ prefix (playbook check passed).
seed_data_creation: Created isolated auth test users via /api/auth/register: test_refactor_<random>@example.com and pytest-generated users from existing suites.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL used from frontend/.env. New regression test file covers requested refactor scope. Current failing tests: CORS credentials/origin preflight and brute-force lockout. Existing gamification + match story suites still pass 13/13.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: (1) OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin header returns wildcard CORS and missing allow-credentials at public endpoint, indicating proxy/edge CORS policy override or deployment config mismatch vs backend code. (2) Send 5 invalid admin login attempts, then valid admin credentials; response remains 200, confirming no lockout control in auth flow. Mitigation: enforce centralized auth rate-limiting/lockout (IP+account), return 423/429 with retry-after, and align ingress CORS with explicit trusted origins + credentials.
